diffs.diff: magnetic_field_uT: datasheet reading gives 0.15 per count, the part's model has 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.007634, 0.007634, 0.007634, 0.002995
diffs.evidence: DS-000189 v1.3 section 3.3 Magnetometer Specifications: 'Sensitivity Scale Factor 0.15 µT / LSB', full-scale ±4900 µT; AK09916 data table (p.78): 0x0001 = 0.15 µT, little-endian two's complement. The model already uses exactly this: driver constant _MAG_UT_PER_LSB = 0.15 applied to little-endian HX/HY/HZ words, and the description says '0.15 µT/LSB, ±4900 µT'. The seven listed values are the sim.measures scales for accelerometer (1/16384 g/LSB), gyroscope (1/131 dps/LSB) and temperature (1/333.87 °C/LSB, offset 21), which match the second reading's acceleration_g, angular_rate_dps and temperature_C conversions. The simulator does not model the AK09916 (stated in buildNotes), so no sim measure carries a magnetic scale; the gate compared the magnetometer factor against non-magnetic registers.
